title: Patch power-scaled sections over a finite principal cover
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, F and M be R-modules, and π:F→M an R-linear map. Let q be a natural number and f:Fin q→R satisfy Ideal.span(range f)=R. Suppose N:Fin q→ℕ has N_i>0 for every i, and t_i:M→F are R-linear maps satisfying π∘t_i=f_i^{N_i}id_M for every i. Then there exists an R-linear section s:M→F of π.
lean_statement: ∀ {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {F : Type*} [AddCommGroup F] [Module R F] (π : F →ₗ[R] M) (q : ℕ) (f : Fin q → R) (_hcover : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤) (N : Fin q → ℕ) (_hN : ∀ i, 0 < N i) (t : Fin q → M →ₗ[R] F) (_ht : ∀ i, π.comp (t i) = (f i) ^ (N i) • (LinearMap.id : M →ₗ[R] M)), ∃ s : M →ₗ[R] F, π.comp s = LinearMap.id
